description: BISMARCK — 54 North Dakota Republican legislators have endorsed Julie Fedorchak’s campaign for Congress. “I am thankful for this support from my friends and colleagues in the Legislature,” Fedorchak said. “We have worked tirelessly together for years to advance our conservative priorities, and this strong and consistent leadership has made North Dakota the best place […]

title: Fedorchak for Congress Announces Dozens of Legislative Endorsements - Julie Fedorchak
